title: Lesson 24: Troubleshooting in Production: Diagnosing a Broken Agent Without Breaking It More
description: Diagnostic discipline for a broken agent in production: preserve the evidence before changing anything, change one variable at a time, keep a rollback you can actually use, and keep the client in the loop through the incident.

questions.question: Per the lesson on troubleshooting in production, what is the first move before changing anything in a live system?
options: Restart the gateway to clear the failure
Preserve the evidence (session logs, state, snapshots) so you can diagnose without destroying what you need to understand
Change the highest-risk config first to see if the symptom clears
Tell the client the fix is done so they stop worrying
questions.explanation: The lesson teaches that the most destructive instinct is to start repairing immediately, because the first action to fix often destroys the evidence you needed to understand the failure, so you secure the evidence first.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson's guidance on changing the system?
options: Change several variables at once so the symptom clears faster
Change one variable at a time and prove each change before the next, with a rollback you can actually use
Only change the provider model, never the config
Never change anything without restarting the gateway first
questions.explanation: The lesson teaches the one-variable discipline: each cycle changes exactly one thing, checks the one thing it was meant to change, and only then moves on, so a working fix is something you understand and can reproduce.

questions.question: Per the lesson, what is the committed-to behavior when a client is affected by a live incident?
options: Go silent while you investigate so the client is not worried
Tell the client only after the fix is verified
Send short updates naming the observed failure, the investigation, the blast radius, and the verification target
Blame the model so the client knows it is not your fault
questions.explanation: The lesson teaches that the failure mode to avoid is going silent, and a short update that names the symptom, the investigation, the blast radius, and the verification target earns trust by showing work rather than claiming it.
